GOV-F-003-S40.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S40.description: Define and implement the MongoDB schema and data contract for Brain locks including owner_id, ttl_expiry, status (active, expired, recoverable), and audit fields. Ensure backward compatibility with any existing lock records.

GOV-F-003-S41.title: Lock Management API Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S41.description: Implement internal API methods for lock acquire, renew, release, and recover operations. Ensure consistent interface for Brain runner and loop components, with validation and error handling for invalid ownership or expired locks.

GOV-F-003-S42.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S42.description: Integrate TTL, ownership validation, and recovery logic into Brain runner execution flow. Ensure every assignment execution acquires, renews, and releases locks correctly, and handles expired locks safely.
